verdict.rationale: Perplexity markets a named 'Deep Research' mode for deeper exploration (perplexity-docs-8, perplexity-docs-27) and promises cited sources for every answer (perplexity-docs-12). Labs is positioned for building reports (perplexity-docs-10), and Computer can autonomously search and browse the web for multi-step work (perplexity-docs-5, perplexity-docs-17). Community reports lower confidence without overturning the capability: one user found references frequently mismatched to the text (perplexity-comm-6), and another found the Computer research feature often fails to trigger or stalls (perplexity-comm-7). Missing for 10: detailed docs on how Deep Research autonomously searches many sources and on its report structure and length, plus independent hands-on corroboration that Deep Research reports have accurate citations.
